facts.evidence: Systemwide sales, which include franchisee sales not recorded as revenue, rose 5% (4% constant currency) to $37 billion.
Revenues were $7,099 million, up 4% (2% constant currency).
Diluted EPS was $3.32, up 6% (5% constant currency).
U.S. comparable sales rose 0.8% (2.5% in Q2 2025). Growth came from higher average check, including favorable product mix, partly offset by negative comparable guest counts.
Operating income was $3,338 million, up 3% (2% constant currency).
Global comparable sales rose 1.3%, versus 3.8% in Q2 2025.

It reflected $52 million of pre-tax charges ($43 million in Q2 2025), primarily restructuring under Accelerating the Organization. (The $52 million, pre-tax basis, quarter and cause are all right. The brief leaves out the $0.06 per-share amount but does not misstate it.)
Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $3.38 versus $3.19 in Q2 2025, up 6% (5% constant currency).
Across 70 markets, Systemwide sales to loyalty members for the trailing twelve months rose over 20% to $40 billion.
The company appointed Skye Anderson President of McDonald's USA.

claims.claim: McDonald's Q2 2026 diluted EPS rose 6% to $3.32.
Global comparable sales rose 1.3% in Q2 2026.
U.S. comparable guest counts were negative in Q2 2026.
Global comparable sales rose 3.8% in Q2 2025.
Comparable sales exclude currency translation.
Q2 2026 revenues were $7,099 million.
Revenues rose 4% (2% in constant currency).
Systemwide sales include franchisee sales that are not recorded as revenue.
Systemwide sales rose 5% (4% in constant currency) to $37 billion.
Operating income was $3,338 million, up 3% (2% in constant currency).
Q2 2026 operating income reflected $52 million of pre-tax charges, mainly restructuring under Accelerating the Organization.
Q2 2025 results reflected $43 million of pre-tax charges.
Excluding both years' charges, operating income rose 4% (2% in constant currency).
Net income was $2,362 million, up 5% (4% in constant currency).
Diluted EPS rose 5% in constant currency.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $3.38, versus $3.19 in Q2 2025.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 6% (5% in constant currency).
U.S. comparable sales rose 0.8%, versus 2.5% in Q2 2025.
U.S. comparable sales growth came from higher average check, including favorable product mix, partly offset by negative comparable guest counts.
International Operated Markets comparable sales rose 1.5%, led by Germany, Australia and the U.K., partly offset by France.
International Developmental Licensed Markets comparable sales rose 1.9%, led by Japan, partly offset by negative comparable sales in China.
Excluding charges, results were mainly driven by higher sales-driven Franchised margins and higher Other operating income, partly offset by higher SG&A.
Reported 'Other' SG&A rose 19% to $706 million.
Other operating (income) expense, net was $37 million of income, versus $29 million of expense in Q2 2025.
Across 70 markets, trailing-twelve-month Systemwide sales to loyalty members rose over 20% to $40 billion.
Loyalty users active in the last 90 days rose 13% to nearly 220 million at quarter-end.
The release provides no guidance or outlook.
The company appointed Skye Anderson President of McDonald's USA.
The CEO cited 'an opportunity to raise the bar in the U.S.'
The CEO gave no targets.
The release contains no balance sheet, cash flow, dividend or buyback figures.
The release defines free cash flow but does not report it.
Diluted weighted average shares were 711.1 million, versus 717.6 million in Q2 2025 (down 1%).
Interest expense rose 5% to $409 million.
Q2 2026 charges totalled $52 million.
Net income rose 5% and pre-tax income rose 3%.
The tax provision fell 6% to $574 million.
